mapper.select: SELECT pt.point_tmpl_id, pt.device_tmpl_id, pt.alarm_code, pt.point_name, pt.type, pt.unit, pt.display_precision, pt.is_deleted, pt.create_time, pt.update_time, (dt.device_tmpl_name NOT LIKE 'MOCK\_%') AS isReal FROM point_template pt LEFT JOIN device_template dt ON pt.device_tmpl_id = dt.device_tmpl_id WHERE pt.device_tmpl_id = #{deviceTmplId} AND pt.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY pt.point_tmpl_id

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO point_template (device_tmpl_id, alarm_code, point_name, type, unit, display_precision) VALUES (#{deviceTmplId}, #{alarmCode}, #{pointName}, #{type}, #{unit}, #{displayPrecision})
mapper.update: UPDATE point_template SET alarm_code = #{alarmCode}, point_name = #{pointName}, type = #{type}, unit = #{unit}, display_precision = #{displayPrecision} WHERE point_tmpl_id = #{pointTmplId}
UPDATE point_template SET type = COALESCE(type, #{type}), unit = COALESCE(unit, #{unit}), update_time = NOW() WHERE point_tmpl_id = #{pointTmplId}
